protocol.weights: all 24 actual Q6_K down tensors: one K12288 dense and 23 K1024 shared-expert
protocol.timing: 21 counterbalanced HIP-event samples, 20 complete-family cycles per sample
protocol.correctness: 73,728 actual-weight BF16 outputs against retained pack8
protocol.control: raw Q6_K pack8 local128 with one K256 scale table per barrier pair

llama_cpp_source_review.mechanism: compact raw Q6_K, vector4 activation and ql/qh loads, 16 lanes per K256 block, four K256 blocks processed concurrently by wave64, and two output rows per workgroup
llama_cpp_source_review.important_correction: The Vulkan Q6_K decode matvec consumes vectorized floating-point activations; reusable Q8_1 packing describes its MMQ/prefill route, not this decode shader.

decision.reason: Every exact HIP geometry/staging candidate loses to the retained pack8 kernel on the complete streaming family. Reproducing Vulkan's different vector4/wave64 reduction tree would change the frozen BF16 association and is not an exact staging optimization.
decision.cleanup: Removed all candidate kernels, wrappers, tests, and leaf harness. Production remains unchanged at 21.851538 tok/s.
